newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen flat or down on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen flat or down on Tuesday.

text.p: Polish shares were seen flat or down on Tuesday after the market's three-session gain and Monday's stronger selling both after price-fixing and at continuous trade.

Analysts said the market was cheered to have put the large mid-year public offerings of Bank Handlowy and copper firm KGHM Polska Miedz behind it, but the run-up to September's parliamentary vote would likely dampen buying.
Some analysts said the 22-percent oversubscription in the institutional tranche of KGHM's public offering announced over the weekend was surprisingly low.
But they said Monday's news the domestic tranche was 62 percent oversubscribed provided some upside potential for the stock at its bourse debut due on Thursday.
